open.text: A whimsical magical vending machine waking up: a soft electric hum, a bright two-note glassy chime and a little sparkle twinkle. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.

close.text: A soft plastic button click followed by a short gentle descending glass chime. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.

pick.text: A clear bright bubbly pop with a short sparkly glass chime, a cheerful game menu selection sound. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.

buy.text: Three small magical glowing coins clinking down into a metal slot, then a sparkly bright cha-ching with a twinkle. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.

rumble.text: A small toy vending machine rattling and shaking with suspense: clunky gears whirring and grinding, glass capsules jostling, building up faster and faster. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.

launch.text: A cartoon pneumatic cannon pop with a springy boing, followed by a rising whistle whoosh of something flying into the air. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.

land.text: A small plastic capsule plopping onto a felt table, bouncing twice with soft cute thuds, then cracking open with a little sparkle pop. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.

scamper.text: Many tiny cartoon creature feet scampering and racing quickly across a tabletop, frantic pitter-patter, playful and comedic. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.

trip.text: A cartoon trip and tumble: a comedic slip, a soft bonk, and a little rolling flump, slapstick. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.

chomp.text: A cute cartoon creature gobbling a snack: two quick crunchy chomps, happy munching and a satisfied little gulp. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.

win.text: A short triumphant cheerful victory fanfare sting played on a toy glockenspiel and kazoo, ending with sparkles, whimsical and funny.

drumroll.text: A quick snare drum roll building in suspense, ending on a soft cymbal tap. Close-up, dry, no voices.

denied.text: A soft cartoon error buzz, a short low double honk meaning nope. Close-up, dry, no music, no voices.
